No running or cardio is included, since your plan already covers that.","title":"5K Support Lifting","days":[{"name":"Strength A","exercises":[{"key":"dumbbell-goblet-squat","sets":4,"reps":5,"repsTo":0,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hold the dumbbell at your chest, sit between your heels."},{"key":"dumbbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":5,"repsTo":0,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lower with control, drive up evenly."},{"key":"dumbbell-bent-over-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep your back flat and pull toward your hip."},{"key":"dumbbell-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hinge at the hips, keep the dumbbells close to your legs."},{"key":"calf-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause briefly at the top."}]},{"name":"Strength B","exercises":[{"key":"dumbbell-split-squat","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep your front foot flat, control the descent."},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":6,"repsTo":8,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Use a low incline on the bench, press evenly."},{"key":"single-arm-dumbbell-row","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Brace on the bench and row to your hip."},{"key":"single-leg-dumbbell-romanian-deadlift","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Balance over one leg, hinge with a flat back."},{"key":"forearm-plank","sets":3,"reps":30,"repsTo":45,"seconds":30,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep your body in a straight line."}]}],"unmet":[]}
